holds.reason: The rear and top of the head contain a large irregular opening, while a long jagged missing strip runs down the back/drapery with exposed interior and stray colored surfaces. The frontal likeness matches A164, but a coherent complete captured head/back is not established. This is a freestanding figure, so the gap is not the expected unrecorded mounting back of a wall relief.

Full-resolution overhead source image shows most of the crown/top of the head as an open crater with a jagged rim below the hairline and visible hollow interior. The frontal body/dress/basket are coherent and match A179, but the missing cranial surface is not justified by documentation of the physical plaster.

Overhead and side views expose a wide opening through the rear/top of the cap/head, with uncaptured gaps around the body/support interior and irregular extended base flaps. The eagle and frontal group match A44, but the missing head surface prevents acceptance as a complete freestanding capture.
